title: Resolution urging Albany to expand C-PACE clean energy financing
summary: This resolution calls on the Governor to sign S.1335-B/A.5404-B, which would expand the state's Commercial Property Assessed Clean Energy (C-PACE) program to cover water improvements, resiliency improvements and, in cities over 1 million people, low carbon building components. It would let property owners get financing for these upgrades repaid through property tax assessments, helping them meet Local Law 97 emissions requirements.
